summary: Tested BDE Tasks page enhancements: Advanced filters panel, table columns (Status, Created/Assigned, Link), Create Task modal with Work Link field, and Task Detail modal. Fixed API endpoint bug for loading users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BDE Tasks page enhancements fully tested and working. Fixed API endpoint from /api/users/list to /api/users/basic for non-admin users to load user list.

status_column_in_table.details: Status column shows status badge (pending, in_progress, completed, on_hold)

created_assigned_column.details: Shows 'Created by you' badge for tasks created by logged-in user, 'Assigned to you' badge for assigned tasks

link_column.details: Shows link icon when work_link is present, '-' when not

date_filter_dropdown.details: Options: Today (default), All Time, Date Range

assigned_to_filter.details: Options: All, Myself, and list of users

assigned_by_filter.details: Options: All, and list of users

type_filter.details: Options: All Types, General, Meeting, Follow Up, Proposal, Call

status_filter.details: Options: All Status, Pending, In Progress, Completed, On Hold

reset_filters_button.details: Resets all filters to default values

create_task_work_link_field.details: Work Link (File/Project URL) field present with placeholder

task_detail_work_link_section.details: Shows Work Link section with clickable link when work_link exists

task_detail_assigned_by.details: Shows 'by [name]' under Assigned To section when assigned_by is set

users_api_endpoint.issue: Frontend was calling /api/users/list which doesn't exist, and /api/users requires admin role
users_api_endpoint.fix: Created new /api/users/basic endpoint for all authenticated users and updated frontend to use it
